reference.sentence: I studied biology at university. ___ allowed me to get a job in a lab.
I'm currently taking an English course. ___ will give me more opportunities to find a job.
reference.explanation: This (singular, presente) retoma el curso que estoy haciendo ahora.

reference.sentence: We use computers and tablets every day. ___ inventions have changed our lives.
I interviewed many students last year. ___ students who answered online were the youngest.
When I was a child, we didn't have mobile phones. ___ days were much simpler.
Look at ___ shoes I'm wearing — I bought them yesterday!
My grandfather fought in the war. ___ experience changed him forever.
Prices are rising every month. ___ is making life very difficult for families.
I failed my driving test three times. ___ was the worst year of my life. (singular, pasado)
We are recycling more and using less plastic. ___ changes are helping the environment. (plural, presente)
In 2010 I lived in London and worked in a café. ___ were the best years of my life. (plural, pasado)
I'm learning to cook now. ___ is something I've always wanted to do. (singular, presente)

substitution.sentence: Peter didn't want to study, but I ___.
substitution.explanation: Did sustituye al verbo (wanted to study).

substitution.sentence: Mary doesn't like coffee, but her brother ___.
substitution.explanation: Does sustituye a 'likes coffee' (present simple).

substitution.sentence: Peter didn't buy a new car, but I did ___.
substitution.explanation: Did so = verbo + objeto (bought a new car). (Regla DO / DOES / DID + SO: repetir la acción.)

substitution.sentence: They promised to clean the house before we arrived, and they did ___.
substitution.explanation: Did so = cleaned the house. (Regla DO / DOES / DID + SO: repetir la acción.)

substitution.sentence: I can play the piano. — So ___ I.
substitution.explanation: So + aux (can) + sujeto. (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

substitution.sentence: I went to the cinema yesterday. — So ___ I.
substitution.explanation: So + did + sujeto (pasado). (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

substitution.sentence: I didn't study French at school. — ___ did I.
substitution.explanation: Neither / Nor + aux + sujeto (= me neither). (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

substitution.sentence: I haven't seen that film. — Nor ___ I.
substitution.explanation: Nor + have + sujeto (present perfect). (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

substitution.sentence: I'm really tired today. — So ___ I.
substitution.explanation: So + am + I (verbo be). (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

substitution.sentence: Are you going to pass the test? — I hope ___.
substitution.explanation: Hope so = that I will pass the test.

substitution.sentence: Is it going to rain tomorrow? — I expect ___.
substitution.explanation: Expect not = I expect that it won't rain.

substitution.sentence: Will the exam be difficult? — I don't think ___.
substitution.explanation: Think se niega con don't: I don't think so.

substitution.sentence: Will it rain during the wedding? — I hope ___.
substitution.explanation: Con hope, la negativa es not (✗ I don't hope so).

substitution.sentence: Are you free tomorrow? If ___, we can go to the cinema.
substitution.explanation: If so = if you are free tomorrow.

substitution.sentence: Are you free tomorrow? If ___, we can meet up another day.
substitution.explanation: If not = if you aren't free.

substitution.sentence: I've bought a new car. — Are you talking about the ___ that is parked outside?
substitution.explanation: One sustituye a 'car' (singular).

substitution.sentence: I have many books. The ___ on the table are mine.
substitution.explanation: Ones sustituye a 'books' (plural).

substitution.sentence: This project is by far the most interesting ___ that I've ever done.
substitution.explanation: The most interesting one = el proyecto más interesante.

substitution.sentence: My old phone was broken, so I bought a new ___.
substitution.explanation: A + adjetivo + one.

substitution.sentence: Do you think this is a good point to start with? If ___, we can start talking about it.
substitution.explanation: If so (Speaking Part 3).

ellipsis.sentence: I saw a film and ___ enjoyed it.
ellipsis.explanation: Con and se omite el sujeto repetido (I).

ellipsis.sentence: I took a test, but ___ didn't pass it.
ellipsis.explanation: Con but se omite el sujeto repetido (I).

ellipsis.sentence: Peter was tired, but I ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Se omite el adjetivo (tired).

ellipsis.sentence: Which sentence correctly omits the relative pronoun?
options: The house Peter painted is mine.
The man called you is my boss.
The car is outside is mine.
The girl won the prize is my sister.
ellipsis.answer: The house Peter painted is mine.
ellipsis.explanation: Solo se omite cuando es OBJETO (detrás hay un sujeto: Peter).

ellipsis.sentence: The book ___ you lent me was fantastic. (most natural option)
ellipsis.explanation: That / which se pueden omitir: es objeto de una defining relative clause.

ellipsis.sentence: Have you finished working? — Yes, I ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Se omite el verbo tras el auxiliar (have finished).

ellipsis.sentence: Can you play the piano? — Yes, I ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Se omite el verbo tras el modal.

ellipsis.sentence: Is Javi at home? — Yes, he must ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + be (presente, verbo to be).

ellipsis.sentence: He wasn't expelled, but he should ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + have been (pasado con to be).

ellipsis.sentence: Did Peter paint his house? — He may ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + have (pasado, sin to be).

ellipsis.sentence: Is Anna in the office? — She might ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + be.

ellipsis.sentence: Was the parcel delivered? — It should ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Pasado + to be → modal + have been.

ellipsis.sentence: Did they win the match? — They could ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Pasado sin to be → modal + have.

ellipsis.sentence: Has she finished the report? — Yes, she ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Auxiliar solo.

ellipsis.sentence: I didn't go to the party, but my sister ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Auxiliar solo (did = went).

ellipsis.sentence: Are they at the meeting? — They must ___.
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + be.

ellipsis.sentence: I didn't win, but I should ___. (2 words: pasado)
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + have (+ participio).

ellipsis.sentence: Was the window broken? — It may ___. (2 words)
ellipsis.explanation: Modal + have been.

ellipsis.sentence: The film ___ we watched last night was boring.
ellipsis.explanation: That / which es objeto (detrás hay sujeto: we), así que se puede omitir.

ellipsis.sentence: Lucy is clever, but her brother ___. (negativo)
ellipsis.explanation: Se omite el adjetivo: isn't (clever).

book.sentence: There are only a few slices of cake left. Take ___ while you've got the chance.
Because of the snow, all the trains were cancelled. When things like ___ happen, it's better to just relax.
book.explanation: Book: ✗ things like these → ✓ things like that (singular).

book.sentence: The best candidates are ___ that show they have done their homework.
She knows how to produce excellent cakes. And ___ is what matters.
I needed a new camera, so I was delighted when my partner gave me ___ as a present.
We used to go to the cinema every weekend, but we haven't ___ recently.
Most of the class are walking to college now. You should ___ too.
book.explanation: Book: You should do so too (= walk to college).

book.sentence: A: Is Sophie meeting us there? B: I think ___.
My children won't eat green apples. Do you have any red ___?
I've made some sandwiches — would you like ___?
Our neighbours are generally nice, but the ___ in flat 4 aren't very sociable.
I've bought a lot of new shirts, but for gardening I prefer to wear an old ___.
I enjoy romantic films, especially sad ___.
Not many people have read that book, and I'm one of the few that ___.
A year ago I couldn't drive a car, but now I ___.
I really enjoy comedy films, but then I think everyone ___.
Most people liked the film, but I ___.
I told my students to hand in the essay on Monday and all of them did ___.
book.explanation: Book: did so. (Regla DO / DOES / DID + SO: repetir la acción.)

book.sentence: I found it hard when I first joined the club, and so ___ my friends.
book.explanation: Book: so + did + sujeto. (Regla SO / NOR / NEITHER + AUX + SUJETO = también / tampoco; no es 'do so'.)

book.sentence: 'Do you think Real Madrid will win?' 'I guess ___.'
book.explanation: Book: guess so (igual que think so).
